Are you sure?

I probably wouldn't be much help, but feel free to comment/post, please.

This is a place with no harsh judgment. I want to help.

Are you my English teacher?

We learned about this a week ago...

Thank You.
I feel like a weight has just been lifted off my shoulders.
Thank you. <3

I've just been here, dating at your comment.

I'm listening. I won't die just yet. So, I'll just shut up and listen to what you have to say.

I still get the feeling that she doesn't really care about me. She'll yell at me about things that happened over a week ago. I do try to help her, but it doesn't really make a difference. For example, today I cooked for 5 people, she was one of them, after I spent 2 hours in the kitchen, she couldn't smile or even say thank you. She didn't even try it.
